description: This file defines a Flutter widget called HomeScreen, which manages bottom navigation between different tabs: Dashboard, Meal Plan, Food Search, and Profile. It implements a stateful widget that maintains the selected tab index and renders the appropriate screen based on user selection.

classes.description: A StatefulWidget that serves as the main navigation shell for the app.

classes.description: State class for HomeScreen, manages current tab index and builds UI.
